cases.objective: Verify that tapping 'Reload Now' applies the OTA update and reloads the app to the latest version
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Bottom sheet shows title 'Update Ready', description text, 'Reload Now' button, and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Observe the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet displayed over the Home screen

steps.expected_result: App begins reloading/updating immediately, showing a loading indicator or briefly going blank before returning to the Home screen on the new version

cases.objective: Verify that tapping 'Maybe Later' dismisses the sheet and schedules the update for the next app open
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Bottom sheet is dismissed and user returns to the Home screen without an immediate reload
steps.step: Tap the 'Maybe Later' link at the bottom of the sheet

steps.expected_result: The OTA update is applied automatically on next launch without showing the 'Update Ready' prompt again

cases.title: Maybe Later defers update to next app launch
